verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an opt-out of model training. That is an adjacent privacy control, not an opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack describes disabling analytics, telemetry, or usage tracking, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You can opt out of model training at any time.
